subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw support `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a public compaction-only reasoning control?
rationale: The PR grows the public config contract, and OpenClaw policy treats new config/default surfaces as high-bar product decisions even when the implementation is otherwise focused.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Approve the key only after the PR wires every local compaction caller and documents the runtime scope and Codex-native warning behavior.

options.title: Defer to broader override work
options.body: Keep this focused PR paused while maintainers decide whether broader per-agent compaction override work should own the thinking-level contract.

options.title: Decline the key
options.body: Keep compaction thinking tied to existing session/provider controls and ask users to manage cost through current model or thinking defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the key only after the PR wires every local compaction caller and documents the runtime scope and Codex-native warning behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and is listed as the Compaction and Context Engine owner in CONTRIBUTING.
